title: Neon Arkanoid
description: Break 30 bricks across five rows. Drag anywhere to move the paddle, or use the native Left and Right controls. Three lives, one board, no device access.

initialState.message: Ready. Drag anywhere to move. Native Left and Right controls also move the paddle. Break all 30 bricks.

children.text: Drag anywhere on the board to move the paddle. Left and Right provide accessible movement. Pause, Resume, and Restart use the same saved game.
